caption: Order of the Court
text: Supreme Court of the United States No. 21A865 (20-1034) ISACCO JACKY SAADA, Applicant v. NARKIS ALIZA GOLAN UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the application to issue the judgment forthwith to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit is granted. /s/ Sonia Sotomayor Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States Dated this 29th day of June, 2022.
